idea-plugin.name: Tide Pets
idea-plugin.description:
Tide Pets — a sea turtle that keeps you company while you code

Shelly the sea turtle lives in a tool window and reacts to what you do:

  • Typing — swims faster
  • Saving — a happy loop and a few bubbles
  • New errors in the open file — looks worried, and hides in its shell when a lot appear at once
  • Errors fixed — celebrates
  • Run configurations — cheers when one passes, hides when one fails
  • Debugging — brings out a magnifying glass
  • Switching files — looks around
  • Idle for a few minutes — naps on the sand
  • Clicked — does a spin

Turn it on or off with Tools → Show Tide Pet.

Made to go with the Midnight Tide theme, and works with any theme.

Free and open source (MIT): github.com/Chelayel/tide-pets.
